results.name: RE panel mounts once in DISASM without replacing the blank project or starting playback
Choosing a ROM is separate from analysis and never changes active authoring state
Actual supported ROM stages room, collision and audio counts without importing or altering history
Preview renders decoded graphics and cell-specific collision overrides instead of treating every shared tile as solid
Untrusted filenames remain literal text in the result and never create markup
Invalid ROM and oversized file failures remain visible and preserve the project
A delayed earlier file read cannot replace a newer staged ROM or status
A delayed hash analysis cannot publish after another file selection
Project changes during analysis reject the preview without overwriting newer edits
Changed project content or lifecycle epoch prevents a staged import
Explicit supported import is a single undoable project replacement and a repeated click does nothing
Project and inspection exports are distinct JSON formats through the existing Save As transport
Download failures leave the staged recovery available and show the actual error
